title: Mjölnir claim budget (P4)
description: The ratchet that makes §94's de-metrics enforceable. The number of unbound public claims may not exceed `maxUnbound`, and `maxUnbound` may only be raised by a dated, owned, EXPIRING exception — the constitution has no permanent waiver path. `target` is the declared trajectory: it is reported, not gated, because a budget that fails on its own first run is a budget people disable.

maxUnbound.description: The maximum number of unbound public claims the build tolerates. This is a debt statement measured by `npm run claims:prose`, not a target somebody picked.

target.description: Where the debt is headed. Must be <= maxUnbound, or the ratchet is pointed the wrong way.

expiresAt.description: An exception without an expiry is a permanent waiver, which the constitution does not have.

history.description: Every ratchet movement, so a budget that was raised and never lowered is visible as debt rather than as a policy.
